title: Report on the General Strike of 1903 in the Netherlands
excerpt: The document details the impact of the 1903 railway strike, noting that participation reached a peak of 80% among railway workers. It specifically highlights the government's harsh response, including the deployment of security forces and the passage of anti-strike legislation (the so-called 'Wurgwetten'). The report includes key minutes from the socialist labor party meeting on March 25th.
full_text: This is a comprehensive report on the general strike of 1903, which paralyzed the Dutch railway system. The high degree of organization among the socialist unions was a key factor in its initial success, but aggressive legislative action eventually broke the strike's momentum. See page 4 for a full breakdown of regional participation numbers and page 7 for the official government response text.
creator: Hendrik Lammers
